title: Fix NaN Loss by Refactoring Env Interface
description: Refactor the ros_gazebo_env.py to use a tuple-based observation interface (obs, privileged_obs) instead of TensorDict, which is causing instability with the recurrent policy. This aligns the environment with rsl_rl's standard and most stable API, aiming to resolve the persistent NaN errors. The forklift_ppo.yaml will also be updated to remove the now-obsolete obs_groups.
